implementation.geometry: Inclusive row-column rectangles in family order, with row, column, block height and block width enumeration
implementation.values: ROI-relative ordered inclusion-exclusion in input precision, followed by alternating-sign rectangle reductions
implementation.providers: NumPy owns object arrays, selection masks and the verified ROI copy. Native C++ owns enumeration, rectangle validation and value evaluation.
implementation.integral_output: int64 with signed input-width rectangle arithmetic and modulo-64-bit reduction
implementation.scratch_buffers: Embedded rectangles are validated before native input reads. Generated windows must fit the actual slice. Supplied windows use actual slice bounds.
implementation.execution: Ordered serial geometry and value loops; default one worker; no separate SIMD or parallel variant
implementation.gaps: Foreign backing buffers and ndarray subclasses are refused. Dimensions must fit native int coordinates. Original error ordering for arbitrary array protocols, nondefault NumPy floating-point policy at overflow, and wider platform behavior require separate evidence.
implementation.fallback: Both APIs use local validation and native operations independently of the fallback switch. Values never call the unchecked original.
